_doc: Ground Block pickups as Ancient Stone Sigils: flat polyominoes inlaid on the floor tile, built from one stone square (forest-integration-pickup-plan-2026-11-05 section 4.2, 2026-11-06). Ramps: top = stone face, lit = lighter upper-left edge, dark = darker lower-right edge, seam = engraved motif and pits (weathering, 2026-11-06); ink = thin dark outline and cracks. width_ratio / height_ratio: share of the cell the shape's bounding box may take; edge_min / edge_max clamp one square (art px). No float, bob, shadow, rotation, particles. Read by src/art/voxel_piece.gd; every key has a default there. weather: motif_min = smallest inner face (px) that gets the square-within-a-square engraving, pits / worn_corners 1 = on.
